# Test fixtures

`soyabean_sehore_2025-10-20_2025-11-20.csv`: 100 real rows extracted from the Phase 1 download of the official
AGMARKNET resource (Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare,
"Variety-wise Daily Market Prices Data of Commodity", Open Government Data Platform India, accessed 26/11/2026,
https://www.data.gov.in/resource/variety-wise-daily-market-prices-data-commodity. Published under Government
Open Data License – India: https://www.data.gov.in/Godl). Mandis Sehore and Ashta (Sehore district, Madhya
Pradesh), before and after the November 2025 " APMC" rename. Values unchanged.

Any other rows used in tests are written inline in the test code, marked as artificial, and exist only to
exercise one rule (for example a non-numeric price or a changed header).
